## Family Stories

Murray was the ninth child of Francis Charles and Amy Telfer, the youngest of the boys. As a small boy he held out his finger to his brother Reg and said "cut it" — and Reg did, with a pair of scissors. He later married Shirley Edna Parker and together they raised three sons: Darryl William, John Robert and Grantley Keith. *(From the Borders to the Bush, pp.139, 175)*
